name: review_editor_frame_read
description: Return JPEGs inline from the open project: the playhead, one time, or up to 12 times in one call. Sequence, group and assembly times read the current edit; Output applies tile layouts and feed treatments and Source shows the untreated recording. The source clock reads any time in one recording by source_id or file, including material the edit no longer uses, for example what plays just before a cut. Start with the default 640-pixel picture, which is enough to identify a shot. Text is reliable only when it is about 8 pixels or taller in the returned picture, and smaller text can be misread without looking wrong. When the result reports native_width and native_height, the picture was reduced: to read on-screen text or other fine detail, ask again with region for that part of the frame at its own pixels, or with a larger max_edge for the whole frame. A region costs far fewer tokens than a large whole frame.

time.description: One frame time: seconds, a clock time such as 19:01.5, or exact rational seconds such as 1001/30000. Supply space with time.

times.description: Several frame times in the same formats, all on the clock in space. The result holds frames, in request order, and one image per frame. Together the images can total 2 MiB.

space.description: Clock of the supplied times. Source is the recording's own clock and needs source_id or file.

source_id.description: With space source: a source_id from project_editor_state_read clips, a transcript word, or a multicam source.

file.description: With space source: absolute path of a recording the project uses or keeps in its undo history.

view.description: Output shows the rendered program. Source shows the untreated recording for correction and review.

angle_id.description: A multicam camera ID for Source review. Omit to use the camera selected at that time.

max_edge.description: Longest image edge in pixels. Defaults to 640. 1280 reads most on-screen text in HD footage, and 1920 to 2576 in 4K. Token cost grows with the area, so prefer region for detail and lower this to 320 for a contact sheet of many times.

region.description: Return only this part of the picture, keeping its own pixels up to max_edge. Use it to read small detail in 4K or larger footage. Fractions of the picture from its top left: x 0.5, y 0, width 0.5, height 0.5 is the top right quarter.
